title: Secret Romance #25 Charlton Comics 1973 Bronze Age Romance Cappello Cover 20c
conditionDescription: Spine wear, corner creasing and edge chipping, toning to the back cover - see the close-ups. Please review the photos - they are of the actual copy you will receive.
descriptionText:
Secret Romance #25 (June 1973, Charlton Comics) -- "You Can't Leave Me Now!" Bronze Age romance with the Cappello hospital-bed cover. Back cover carries the Wayne School "Never finished high school?" ad. Cover price 20c US.

Condition: Good, reading copy. Cover shows spine wear, corner creasing and edge chipping, with toning to the back cover (see the corner close-ups). Please review the photos - they are of the actual copy you will receive.
